# cost

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The session's API cost as a transcript stat, up to the reading position: what the conversation had cost at API prices by the last row on screen — its own transcripts and every sub-agent it launched, workflow agents included, a sub-agent's spend counted when it happened. At the end it reads the live usage totals (conversations.usage, with the tokens behind it on hover); scrolled back, the cost at that row's instant (conversations.usage.cost-at), keeping the last priced reading while the next one loads.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `TranscriptStats.Item` "cost" → `CostStat`
  - Uses:
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer.useJsonlConversationId`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer.useTranscriptSubject`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/transcript-stats.StatBadge`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/transcript-stats.TranscriptStats`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/transcript-stats.useTranscriptRead`
    - `network/live.useLive`
